what.text: This page follows refugees from Côte d'Ivoire in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 32506 refugees from Côte d'Ivoire.
France hosts the largest share, 70.6%, followed by Italy, Germany and Liberia.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Ivory Coast from 2002 to 2004, with the MPCI, MPIGO, MJP and FRCI.
It records armed conflict again in 2011, with FDSI-CI and FRCI.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1991 at 15 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 154818, at the end of 2011, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2011 to 2013.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, reported to UNHCR.
